comment: Which shipped skill must be loaded before a file of this project is changed. Read by .claude/hooks/skill-check.py. 'paths' are globs relative to the project root; 'content' are regular expressions matched against the text being written; a rule applies when any path or any content pattern matches. A skill counts as loaded once the session invoked it or read its SKILL.md; a skill the project does not have is skipped. This file belongs to the template - add project specific rules, and rules for skills of your own, to .claude/skill-map.custom.json in the same format.
